resources.string:
Gymfy only reads or writes Health Connect if you turn that on in Gymfy's Settings → Health Connect. Both switches are off until you do.

Write workouts (write exercise): when you finish a workout, Gymfy adds one exercise session — strength training, its start and end time, and the workout's name. No sets, weights, notes, measurements or photos. Past workouts are written only if you tap "Write past workouts". While writing is on, deleting a workout in Gymfy deletes its session here too.

Read bodyweight (read weight): when you open Gymfy, it reads weight records from the last 30 days and fills in your bodyweight on days where you have not entered one — the first weigh-in of each day. A weight you typed is never replaced, and no record is imported twice. Nothing else is read.

Everything stays on this phone. Gymfy has no internet access and sends nothing anywhere. Apps you allow to read exercise data from Health Connect can see the workouts Gymfy wrote.

To stop, turn the switch off in Gymfy. To revoke access or delete what Gymfy wrote, use Health Connect's settings for Gymfy, or "Manage in Health Connect" in Gymfy. Workouts already written stay in Health Connect until you delete them there.
